parsed.explanation: Combined regime imposes Tier-1 universal exposures: birth-sex passports/federal facilities, a state ban on multi-occupancy restrooms, changing areas and sleeping quarters by biological sex, documented trespass arrest and men's-ward holding, entry discrepancy/fraud scrutiny, and birth-sex custody with hormone removal and reported immigration-custody abuse. Contested litigation, valid existing X passports, national hate-crime and employment recourse, and three protective city ordinances prevent a 0.25 rating, but no working remedy overrides the facility, document, entry and custody exposures, including for minors.

entry_documents.exposure: Passport sex is assigned at birth; new X passports stopped, confiscations/blocking reported. Entry cable directs refusal on sex discrepancy and consideration of permanent fraud ineligibility for suspected misrepresentation.
entry_documents.protection: Existing X passports valid until expiration. Fraud finding requires four elements, is never automatic, and limited waivers exist. Challenged in court.
entry_documents.interaction: Document mismatch can convert at entry into refusal, investigation, detention and birth-sex placement; advisories from eight-plus governments document traveller concern.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Arrest example: handcuffed, trespass charge, 24 hours in men's ward, up to 60 days. National corrections model includes short haircuts, hormone removal, psychiatric substitution. Immigration custody reports forced labour, beatings, solitary and severe sexual abuse.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Trespass offence requires willful entry and refusal to depart when asked, with listed exemptions. Several executive orders enjoined; lawsuits pending.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Entry discrepancy or facility arrest can lead to detention where birth-sex placement and care denial are documented; visitor frequency of detention not documented.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Federal binary-sex rule bars government-funded facilities congruent with identity. This state reserves public multi-occupancy restrooms, changing areas and sleeping quarters by biological sex, with civil cause of action; schools require birth-sex restrooms.
federal_state_facilities.protection: Ban mainly government-owned buildings in most mapped states; some private inclusive practice and three city public-accommodation ordinances exist, but do not override state/federal rules.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Every federal and public facility encounter carries exposure regardless of local hospitality; private venues cannot cure the public rule.

care_services.exposure: Gender-affirming care for minors banned in this state and 27 states nationally; proposed federal bar on public insurance under 18. Custody hormone removal documented. Airport guide notes screening can out trans travellers.
care_services.protection: No documented visitor care shield or trans-specific emergency-care protection. Some orders blocked or enjoined, status unresolved.
care_services.interaction: Emergency treatment, medication continuation and a minor's care can become subjects of investigation or denial; ward placement exposure is documented via sleeping-quarters rule.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Official framing presents trans inclusion as danger to women/children; 2026 counterterrorism strategy prioritizes 'radically pro-transgender' groups; DOJ reward memo invokes 'radical gender ideology.' No general presentation imprisonment documented.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Courts have enjoined several orders; national hate-crime statute covers gender identity, Supreme Court requires employment protection.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Threat framing supports facility and document enforcement and raises police-call/ejection risk, without amounting to documented organised sweeps of visitors.

minors_guardians.exposure: School law requires birth-sex restrooms for pre-K upward, with only a non-multi-occupancy accommodation. Youth care ban, order directing investigation/prosecution of teachers facilitating social transition, hospital-record subpoenas.
minors_guardians.protection: Reasonable accommodation is limited to not using multi-occupancy facilities; no documented travelling-minor shield.
minors_guardians.interaction: A trans minor travelling with a guardian faces school/public facility, sports and care restrictions; guardian may face investigation exposure in school settings.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: No state hate-crime statute and no state public-accommodation nondiscrimination protection. Poll shows majority support birth-sex documents/sports rules, indicating hostile social framing can escalate.
street_violence_police_response.protection: National hate-crime law covers gender identity; three cities prohibit gender-identity discrimination in public accommodations. No state-specific incident/outcome data documented.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: If assaulted or ejected, traveller must rely on national recourse and patchy local ordinances while state law itself restricts facilities.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Passport lawsuit, challenges to executive orders and proposed health rules unresolved. No documented effective remedy for facility exclusion, custody hormone denial or entry confiscation.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Legal-aid FAQ, civil-liberties litigation and some judicial injunctions show contested, functioning courts, but injunctions are partial and measure-dependent.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Uncertainty itself is exposure: traveller cannot know which rules will operate at travel time; absence of outcome data is not safety.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar: birth-sex public toilets, document checking, courts rejecting exclusion complaints, no offence for being trans. This case adds entry fraud scrutiny, trespass arrest/custody harm and threat framing, pushing slightly toward 0.35 rather than above it.

Lower: 0.45-A has bathroom removal risk but ordinary emergency care, no entry regime, no arrest, no custody abuse and one prosecuted assault. Here those additional documented exposures make universal facility exclusion more consequential.

Higher: 0.25-C has repeated presentation arrests, passport confiscation/extortion and birth-sex custody abuse as routine police practice. Here no organised visitor sweeps or extortion are documented, fraud/arrest require specific triggers, and litigation/injunctions remain active.

parsed.synthesis: The operative interaction is document/presentation mismatch at entry or in a public facility triggering refusal, trespass enforcement, detention and birth-sex placement, with hormone/care denial documented in custody. State and federal rules reinforce each other; city ordinances, national hate-crime/employment recourse and injunctions do not override them. Minors face added school, sports and care restrictions. This places the regime at the 0.35 anchor tier: unremedied Tier-1 exposure with state threat framing, but without documented routine imprisonment, extortion sweeps or execution risk.
